Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE

 INTO :s_new_product_code_desc, temp_new_product_type

 WHERE product_code = :new_product_code 
 AND unit_scheme_type = 'C'
 AND sysdate between eff_date AND
 nvl(term_date,sysdate);

 THEN

 THEN

 END IF;

 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then

 then

 END;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUPLI_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dupli_check IS
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 temp_v_old_prod varchar2(50);
 temp_v_new_prod varchar2(10);
 temp_v_aliquot varchar2(50);
 temp_v_sort_sequence varchar2(50);
 temp_v_item_name varchar2(50);
 temp_c_rec_no VARCHAR2(2);
 BEGIN
 temp_v_old_prod := :old_product_code;
 temp_v_new_prod := :new_product_code;
 temp_v_aliquot := :aliquot;
 temp_v_sort_sequence := :seq_no;
 temp_v_item_name := :system.cursor_item;
 temp_c_rec_no := :system.trigger_record;
 go_record('1');
 LOOP
 IF :old_product_code = temp_v_old_prod AND
 :system.trigger_record != temp_c_rec_no AND
 :new_product_code = temp_v_new_prod AND
 :aliquot = temp_v_aliquot 
 THEN
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 show_error('0319');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 IF :old_product_code = temp_v_old_prod AND
 :system.trigger_record != temp_c_rec_no AND
 :new_product_code = temp_v_new_prod AND
 :seq_no = temp_v_sort_sequence 
 THEN
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 show_error('9718');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 IF :old_product_code = temp_v_old_prod AND
 :system.trigger_record != temp_c_rec_no AND
 :new_product_code = temp_v_new_prod 
 THEN
 IF temp_v_aliquot != temp_v_sort_sequence 
 THEN 
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 show_error('9718');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 THEN
 EXIT;
 ELSE
 DOWN;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 GO_RECORD(temp_c_rec_no);
 GO_ITEM(temp_v_item_name);
 END;
END;
